mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 45 degrees and clear at Fireman's Park. We are under a Waxing Gibbous moon, and keep an eye out for the ISS at 4:59 AM, as it will be visible rising from the direction of Mount Horeb and traveling toward the Northeast near the Home Depot area, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has provided updates on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, where underground utility work is finished and new gravel is being placed. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center is inviting residents to order their daily nutritious Grab and Go lunches, which are available for pickup or dine-in Monday through Friday between 11:30 AM and 12 PM.

There is plenty going on in town! Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday night festivities at ART House 360, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's this Friday.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating the incident further.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit accordingly to enjoy your treat.
